VBO:0200144.summary: Alert, devoted and eager to work, the Belgian Shepherd Dog tends to be watchful with strangers and affectionate with familiar people. Its herding background carries into guarding, tracking and obedience work, with a lively movement that can change direction quickly and circle as it watches. The breed includes four coat varieties, sharing the same working character and balanced outline.
VBO:0200144.shortDescription: An alert, devoted worker, the Belgian Shepherd Dog pairs affection for familiar people with a vigilant herding spirit.
